skill_name: Explain a strategy to design a web application.
workflow: A good strategy for designing a web application is to begin by defining the user's needs and goals for using the application. Once the use cases and features of the web application have been identified, developers should then move on to designing the pages and components of the application. Next, they should prototype the application and test it with users to ensure that it meets their needs.
